Seller '800 rpm rated' contradicts measured Kv; treat as unreliable. Kt 0.52 Nm/A from ODrive's 8.27/Kv rule. No maker publishes torque: at a 20 A driver limit expect roughly 0.52 x 20 = 10 Nm (derived, ignores saturation). Windings vary between factories: buy all from one seller. Hall-only low-speed control is coarse; add an encoder for balancing.
